*Approval of BL 303 before birth (A5)*

A5 visa holder, giving birth at Assaf HaRofe at the end of November. I submitted BL form 303 last week according to the instructions on AIC's website, and today I received the following SMS:

אישור מענק אשפוז יינתן לאחר בדיקה רק לאחר הלידה. עלייך יהיה להעביר אישור בל/303 חתום ע"י בית החולים. שתהייה לידה קלה.

Basically it seems whichever clerk checked my file doesn't know the new procedure. A secretary at Assaf HaRofe said the same thing, that it's only after birth, but I know that's not true anymore.

Anyone else experienced this? How should I approach Bituach Leumi to remind them of the new procedure and that they can/should approve it before the birth?
